name: Timesact Preorder
summary: Shopify pre-orders, deposits and split payments, back-in-stock and coming-soon sign-ups.
best_for: Shopify stores that take pre-orders, deposits or back-in-stock sign-ups on a modest or seasonal volume and want to start free, pay a few dollars a month in quiet months and switch to a fixed price when a launch runs past a hundred or so orders
skip_if: you run Shopify Plus with steady high pre-order volume and object to a price set by your Shopify plan; most of your checkout traffic goes through Shop Pay or other accelerated buttons and you cannot test that path first; or you only need back-in-stock emails, which lighter apps cover
honest_knock:
The Fixed price depends on your Shopify plan, not on what you use. CORE Fixed is $23 a month for a store on Basic Shopify and $117 for a store on Shopify Plus, and the pricing page lists the same unlimited orders and the same CORE features at every level. A Plus store therefore pays five times what a Basic store pays for identical capability. Timesact says so openly, but it means the break-even point moves with your store's size: on Basic, CORE Flexible at $17 for 100 orders is cheaper than Fixed and $37 for 250 is dearer, so Fixed wins somewhere between the two; on Plus, Flexible at $107 for 1,000 orders is still cheaper than the $117 Fixed price.

Several reviewers describe checkout gaps. A two-star review from October 2025, by a store that had used the app for more than two years, says pre-orders did not work for orders placed through Shop Pay, the Buy Button or other accelerated checkout buttons. A merchant who edited their review in February 2026 wrote that the second payment on a split-payment pre-order was charged to customers on the estimated arrival date without a notification to the customer or the store; the co-founder replied publicly and said they had tried to reach the merchant. If you plan to take deposits, test the full flow, including the balance charge and the emails around it, on a test order before you launch a pre-order campaign.

The Fixed plans are labelled a limited-time deal, and the page does not say when the deal ends or what the price becomes afterwards. Yearly billing brings CORE Fixed down to $17 a month on Basic, but if you lock in a year, ask in writing whether the price holds at renewal.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-09-25, re-read 2026-10-21 without changes, on timesact.com/pages/pricing, including its volume selector and yearly toggle, and on the Shopify App Store listing apps.shopify.com/timesact-discount-pre-order, which shows the same figures) Two families of plans, all billed in USD through Shopify every 30 days with no transaction fees. Free costs $0 and covers 20 orders a month on unlimited products, unlimited email sending and sign-ups, unlimited coming-soon and low-stock states, and support, with Timesact branding on the storefront; the App Store card labels it Free (New Users). Flexible plans are usage-based: CORE Flexible starts at $5 a month for 10 orders and adds deposits, split payments, $0-down pre-orders, CSV upload, pre-order by product tag, SMS, 30 days of analytics and branding removal, at $0.20 per order past the volume you pick; PRO Flexible starts at $7 for 10 orders and adds market and location targeting, storewide automatic back-in-stock and low-stock, charge on fulfilment and analytics without a time window, at $0.30 per order past your volume. The volume selector on the pricing page lists CORE Flexible at $11 for 50 orders, $17 for 100, $37 for 250, $73 for 500 and $107 for 1,000, and PRO Flexible at $17, $27, $57, $87 and $127 for the same volumes. SMS costs from $0.02 a message for US numbers, only if you use it. Fixed plans cover unlimited orders at one price, marked as a limited-time deal, and the price follows your Shopify subscription: CORE Fixed is $23 a month on Basic Shopify, $47 on Grow, $73 on Advanced and $117 on Plus ($17, $37, $57 and $93 a month billed yearly; the listing puts the Basic yearly price at $204), and PRO Fixed is $27, $57, $87 and $147 ($21, $43, $67 and $117 billed yearly). A Merchandising add-on (hiding sold-out products, merchant alerts by email and Slack) is $10 a month on any plan, Free included.

compare_with.name: Notify Me
compare_with.why: Notify Me is the closest comparison in our own dossiers, because it also combines pre-orders and back-in-stock alerts and also charges $0.20 per pre-order past the plan limit. Its ladder (read 23 September 2026) runs on flat tiers with caps: a free Lite tier whose allowances are mostly lifetime rather than monthly (5 pre-orders over the life of the store), Kickstart at $9.90 a month and Starter at $19.90 with 500 alerts and 500 pre-orders, and Standard at $39.90 with 1,500 of each. Timesact's Free plan resets every month at 20 orders, its Flexible plans let you buy exactly the volume you expect from $5, and its Fixed plans remove the cap entirely from $23 on Basic Shopify. A small store testing pre-orders gets more for nothing from Timesact; a store whose main need is back-in-stock alerts and wishlists, with pre-orders on the side, fits Notify Me's structure better.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Timesact Pre-order on a Shopify development store: the install, the Free plan, one pre-order for one product set up with the Pre-order template, the app embed saved in the theme, the pre-order badge and button in the theme editor preview, the plan and version screens, the Shopify approval screen for Flexible (not approved) and the uninstall dialog, after which the app was uninstalled. Nothing was paid and no order was placed. Install: the install form was sent at 12:43:34 in our own tab; Shopify showed the Install app dialog with View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data, and the install was approved. The app opened on Timesact Pre-order on the plan FREE (Your plan: FREE, Price: FREE, 0 used out of 20, 20 are from free plan, Next order reset 1-12-2026). No separate account, demo or call was asked; the buttons Call me back and Chat with Us were optional. The setup guide said Enable Timesact in your theme. Core action, set up one pre-order for one test product, about 4 minutes (12:43 to about 12:47) and about 24 steps: (1) Products, Add Products and The 3p Fulfilled Snowboard; (2) the message You don't have any Customer Experiences yet., and the template Pre-order (label CORE plan), which gave Customer Experience duplicated and the name Pre-order (Copy); (3) the product was picked again, the experience assigned and saved; the status first read Pre-order - On standby because the default is Only when out of stock and the product had 20 in stock; (4) in the functionality settings we chose Always, whatever the stock level, which gave Customer Experience saved and the status Pre-order - Active, start 17/11/26 - unlimited; (5) Enable app embed opened the theme editor in a NEW tab, where we switched on Timesact V2 and SAVED the theme (Changes saved.), so the app embed is on in the theme of our development store; (6) in the theme editor preview of the product page a badge Pre-Order, the choice One-time Purchase $2,629.95 or Pre-order (Copy) $2,629.95, the button Pre-Order and the text Pre-order delivers as soon as available. appeared. Not tested in the core action: a real order, a deposit or split payment, Shop Pay or accelerated checkout. Plans: Billing & Account shows Plans & pricing for the CORE version. Free: $0.00 a month, 20 free orders per month, Starting at $0.02 per SMS (US), FREE and CORE Customer Experiences, email, chat and video help and a Guided setup call, with an optional add-on of $10.00/month. Flexible: $5.00 $0.50 / month, then $5.00/month (Black Friday 90% off first month), 10 orders per month and $0.20 per additional order. Fixed: $23.00 $2.30 / month, then $23.00/month (Black Friday 90% off first month), Unlimited orders and No additional cost, with a choice Monthly or yearly (SAVE $72 on yearly). The version choice has CORE (split payments, limits, discounts, custom domain emails, Klaviyo, CSV, POS, Wishlist, Flow, 30-day analytics) and PRO (markets and locations, storewide auto Low Stock and Back in Stock, unlimited analytics period, charge on fulfillment). We saw only the volume 10 orders per month on Flexible and did not open the other volumes. Checkout: Upgrade on Flexible opened a box Enhance your plan with the add-on (optional) at $10.00 / month and then Activate your subscription: Plan $5.00/month, First month: $0.50, then $5.00/month. This led to the Shopify Approve subscription screen: Timesact CORE FLEXIBLE, $0,50 USD every 30 days after discount, Total Due 17 Nov $0,50, a note that the app bills a recurring subscription and usage charges, and an Add payment method row. The sentence about a test charge was NOT on this screen and Approve was greyed out, so we did not approve; no card was entered; we pressed Cancel. Cancelling: no paid plan was ever active, so there was nothing to cancel. Removing the app goes through Settings, Apps, the row of the app, the menu and Uninstall; the dialog says you will no longer be able to use the app, that any data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted, and that a request goes to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information. A reason is required (Testing multiple apps); the free feedback was left empty. The app is gone from the installed apps. Not tested: deposits and split payments, Shop Pay and accelerated checkout, a mixed cart, the balance payment, emails, SMS, the Merchandising add-on, PRO, the yearly plan, the other Flexible volumes, cancelling a paid plan and Wishlist. Clean up: the app was uninstalled at about 12:50 with the reason Testing multiple apps. The app embed Timesact V2 had been switched on and saved in the theme; it goes away with the app but may remain as a leftover theme setting. The product itself was not changed. One of our own tabs, the theme editor opened by the Enable app embed button, could not be closed with our tools. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The default setting Only when out of stock left the pre-order on standby for a product with stock, the app embed had to be switched on in the theme editor in a new tab and saved, and the Flexible approval screen needs a payment method, has no test charge sentence and shows usage charges on top of the subscription.

Install: the install form was sent at 12:43:34 in our own tab; Shopify showed the Install app dialog with View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data, and the install was approved. The app opened on Timesact Pre-order on the plan FREE (Your plan: FREE, Price: FREE, 0 used out of 20, 20 are from free plan, Next order reset 1-12-2026). No separate account, demo or call was asked; the buttons Call me back and Chat with Us were optional. The setup guide said Enable Timesact in your theme. Core action, set up one pre-order for one test product, about 4 minutes (12:43 to about 12:47) and about 24 steps: (1) Products, Add Products and The 3p Fulfilled Snowboard; (2) the message You don't have any Customer Experiences yet., and the template Pre-order (label CORE plan), which gave Customer Experience duplicated and the name Pre-order (Copy); (3) the product was picked again, the experience assigned and saved; the status first read Pre-order - On standby because the default is Only when out of stock and the product had 20 in stock; (4) in the functionality settings we chose Always, whatever the stock level, which gave Customer Experience saved and the status Pre-order - Active, start 17/11/26 - unlimited; (5) Enable app embed opened the theme editor in a NEW tab, where we switched on Timesact V2 and SAVED the theme (Changes saved.), so the app embed is on in the theme of our development store; (6) in the theme editor preview of the product page a badge Pre-Order, the choice One-time Purchase $2,629.95 or Pre-order (Copy) $2,629.95, the button Pre-Order and the text Pre-order delivers as soon as available. appeared. Not tested in the core action: a real order, a deposit or split payment, Shop Pay or accelerated checkout. Plans: Billing & Account shows Plans & pricing for the CORE version. Free: $0.00 a month, 20 free orders per month, Starting at $0.02 per SMS (US), FREE and CORE Customer Experiences, email, chat and video help and a Guided setup call, with an optional add-on of $10.00/month. Flexible: $5.00 $0.50 / month, then $5.00/month (Black Friday 90% off first month), 10 orders per month and $0.20 per additional order. Fixed: $23.00 $2.30 / month, then $23.00/month (Black Friday 90% off first month), Unlimited orders and No additional cost, with a choice Monthly or yearly (SAVE $72 on yearly). The version choice has CORE (split payments, limits, discounts, custom domain emails, Klaviyo, CSV, POS, Wishlist, Flow, 30-day analytics) and PRO (markets and locations, storewide auto Low Stock and Back in Stock, unlimited analytics period, charge on fulfillment). We saw only the volume 10 orders per month on Flexible and did not open the other volumes. Checkout: Upgrade on Flexible opened a box Enhance your plan with the add-on (optional) at $10.00 / month and then Activate your subscription: Plan $5.00/month, First month: $0.50, then $5.00/month. This led to the Shopify Approve subscription screen: Timesact CORE FLEXIBLE, $0,50 USD every 30 days after discount, Total Due 17 Nov $0,50, a note that the app bills a recurring subscription and usage charges, and an Add payment method row. The sentence about a test charge was NOT on this screen and Approve was greyed out, so we did not approve; no card was entered; we pressed Cancel. Cancelling: no paid plan was ever active, so there was nothing to cancel. Removing the app goes through Settings, Apps, the row of the app, the menu and Uninstall; the dialog says you will no longer be able to use the app, that any data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted, and that a request goes to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information. A reason is required (Testing multiple apps); the free feedback was left empty. The app is gone from the installed apps. Not tested: deposits and split payments, Shop Pay and accelerated checkout, a mixed cart, the balance payment, emails, SMS, the Merchandising add-on, PRO, the yearly plan, the other Flexible volumes, cancelling a paid plan and Wishlist. Clean up: the app was uninstalled at about 12:50 with the reason Testing multiple apps. The app embed Timesact V2 had been switched on and saved in the theme; it goes away with the app but may remain as a leftover theme setting. The product itself was not changed. One of our own tabs, the theme editor opened by the Enable app embed button, could not be closed with our tools. No kit records were entered. claim_checks.comparability: Dossier free plan limit versus the Free card and the usage line in the app.
claim_checks.buying_consequence: The free plan limit of 20 orders a month matches the dossier, and SMS costs extra only when used.

claim_checks.comparability: Dossier Flexible entry price versus the Flexible card at 10 orders per month; the selector was not opened further.
claim_checks.buying_consequence: The entry price of Flexible and the fee per extra order match the dossier; the higher volumes were not checked.

claim_checks.observed: The Flexible and Fixed cards carry a Black Friday label of 90% off first month ($0.50 and $2.30); the dossier prices are list prices and do not mention the deal, and its end date was not shown.
claim_checks.plan: Flexible approval screen, not approved, development store
claim_checks.comparability: Dossier list prices versus a time bound first month deal with no end date; no stored cost rule exists for it.
claim_checks.buying_consequence: The first month costs a tenth of the list price; after that the list price applies.

claim_checks.observed: The Fixed card has a choice Monthly or yearly with SAVE $72 on yearly; the yearly price itself was not opened.
claim_checks.plan: Flexible approval screen, not approved, development store
claim_checks.comparability: Dossier yearly price versus a label on the Fixed card; the yearly view was not opened.
claim_checks.buying_consequence: The yearly price of Fixed could not be checked against the dossier.

claim_checks.observed: The CORE version lists split payments, limits and discounts and the PRO version adds markets and locations, storewide auto Low Stock and Back in Stock, an unlimited analytics period and charge on fulfillment; none of these was tried.
claim_checks.plan: Flexible approval screen, not approved, development store
claim_checks.comparability: Dossier feature lists versus the version cards in the app; no feature beyond the basic pre-order was tried.
claim_checks.buying_consequence: The CORE and PRO features the dossier sells could not be checked beyond the list.

claim_checks.claim: Pre-order delivers as soon as available.
claim_checks.observed: The preview of the product page shows the badge Pre-Order, a choice between One-time Purchase and Pre-order (Copy) at the same price, the button Pre-Order and the text Pre-order delivers as soon as available. The theme embed was switched on in a new tab and saved.
claim_checks.plan: Flexible approval screen, not approved, development store
claim_checks.comparability: Editor preview of the product page versus the assigned experience and the saved embed; checkout was not seen.
claim_checks.buying_consequence: The buyer sees a pre-order badge, button and delivery text in the editor preview; the live storefront and checkout were not seen.

claim_checks.observed: The Shopify approval screen for Flexible shows a subtotal of $5,00, a discount of 90% and a total of $0,50 due 17 Nov plus any applicable taxes, with a note that usage charges come on top. Approve was greyed out and nothing was approved.
claim_checks.plan: Flexible approval screen, not approved, development store
claim_checks.comparability: Dossier Flexible price versus the approval screen amount; no stored cost rule was compared.
claim_checks.buying_consequence: The list price of $5 a month matches the dossier, with a first month of $0,50 now and usage charges on top.
